paragraphs: A Hebrew RTL coffee storefront built with Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript, plain CSS and Supabase. Single-product order requests; no online payments.

The deployed storefront shell and administrator login are reachable. Supabase is not configured yet: products return HTTP 503, and orders cannot be placed. Follow setup below to activate the database-backed application. Do not submit this as a fully functioning order site until that step and hosted verification are complete.
features: Responsive catalog fetched from Supabase, with ten seeded products at the requested prices, ten local Pexels images and named image fallbacks.
Quantity 1–100, live total preview, browser/server validation, normalized Gmail-only email, required trimmed names/address and exactly ten ASCII phone digits stored as text.

A database function reads the current product price and atomically saves integer-agorot price/total snapshots. Client-supplied prices/statuses are discarded. Success appears only after confirmed insertion; pending…

Supabase password login at /admin, one explicitly authorized administrator, newest-first order table with customer/product/pricing details, load-more pagination, sign-out, and persisted Hebrew statuses: חדשה / בטיפול /…

Administrator status filtering defaults to הכול, uses the existing Hebrew status labels, filters in Supabase before pagination, resets to page one on selection changes, and ignores stale responses. Status updates within…

whatItDoes.text: A Hebrew RTL coffee storefront built with Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript, plain CSS and Supabase. Single-product order requests; no online payments.

requirements.text: The deployed storefront shell and administrator login are reachable.

Supabase password login at /admin, one explicitly authorized administrator, newest-first order table with customer/product/pricing details, load-more pagination, sign-out, and persisted Hebrew statuses: חדשה / בטיפול / הושלמה.
There is no public signup, password-recovery flow, payment processing, inventory or delivery charge calculation.
